answer: The delta is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the quartz. The ocean of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, capped per identity per epoch, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
